metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over northern part of Isabela Island greater than the southern part of Isabela Island at 1:20 am local time on January 7, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need VIIRS nighttime lights data (DNB - Day/Night Band) - Specific time: January 7, 2022, 1:20 AM local time - Isabela Island is in the Galápagos, Ecuador (roughly UTC-6) - 1:20 AM local = ~7:20 AM UTC - VIIRS has daily composites but specific overpass times vary - Use VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_L3_GLOBAL_VCMCFG collection or monthly composites - For a specific time, we need to use the daily product closest to that date 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights data already filters for nighttime - May need to mask out low quality pixels or use quality flags - The question is about brightness, so no cloud masking needed for lights 3. Logic: - Define northern and southern parts of Isabela Island (split roughly in half) - Isabela Island spans approximately from -1.08°N to -0.25°N, -91.2°W to -90.8°W - Northern part: above -0.65°N, Southern part: below -0.65°N - Calculate mean brightness for each region - Compare: if north > south → A, else → B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid values) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Isabela Island geometry (Galápagos, Ecuador) // Northern part: roughly above -0.65° latitude const northIsabela = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-91.2, -0.25], [-90.8, -0.25], [-90.8, -0.65], [-91.2, -0.65], [-91.2, -0.25]] ]); // Southern part: roughly below -0.65° latitude const southIsabela = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-91.2, -0.65], [-90.8, -0.65], [-90.8, -1.08], [-91.2, -1.08], [-91.2, -0.65]] ]); // Date: January 7, 2022 const targetDate = '2022-01-07'; // Load VIIRS DNB nighttime lights daily product let collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate('2022-01-01', '2022-01-31') .select('avg_rad'); const colSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No VIIRS data available for January 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the image (monthly composite for January 2022) const image = collection.first(); // Calculate mean brightness for northern part const northStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: northIsabela, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const northBrightness = northStats['avg_rad_mean']; const northCount = northStats['avg_rad_count']; console.log(`North Isabela - Brightness: ${northBrightness}, Pixels: ${northCount}`); // Calculate mean brightness for southern part const southStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: southIsabela, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const southBrightness = southStats['avg_rad_mean']; const southCount = southStats['avg_rad_count']; console.log(`South Isabela - Brightness: ${southBrightness}, Pixels: ${southCount}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (northCount === 0 || southCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in one or both regions.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for null/invalid values if (northBrightness === null || southBrightness === null || isNaN(northBrightness) || isNaN(southBrightness)) { console.log('Invalid brightness values calculated.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare brightness console.log(`Comparison: North (${northBrightness.toFixed(4)}) vs South (${southBrightness.toFixed(4)})`); if (northBrightness > southBrightness) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
